clips.title: The story
paras: On a crag above the Barrens, Falla Sagewind watches the land for signs of trouble. Her camp lies between the Crossroads and the Lushwater Oasis, where she studies changes in nature and magic.

Falla Sagewind keeps camp on a secluded summit southwest of the Crossroads, high above the Barrens trails. From there, she watches the savanna and the changes in its wildlife. She also studies corruption rising from fissures beneath the Wailing Caverns. Her vigil keeps her apart from the daily trade at the Crossroads, but her attention remains on the spirits and wounds of the land.
